title: pulse-publish-on-timeout
motivation: Moves T7 (fundamentals freshness) from 0% → expected ≥90% within one pulse cycle (~4h, given the retry cadence observed in the journal): the fetch step already succeeds each run, so once its output is allowed to publish on a downstream timeout, the cache TTL window (20h for yfinance) is met on the very next successful fetch pass
